description: Only for an assistant that can send the user's file with HTTP PUT, such as a coding agent with a shell. Begins uploading a Modrinth .mrpack (up to 1 GiB). Returns uploadId, key, fileName and parts (url valid one hour): PUT each piece, keep each ETag, then completeModpackUpload. Refused when a modpack is set: deleteModpack removes an uploaded one, updateServer a catalog one.

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. pack.mrpack.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: startModpackUpload
title: Start uploading a custom modpack
